instruction: Add two new papers to the spreadsheet, ensuring that all arxiv links in column B start with 'https://arxiv.org/pdf/' and end with '.pdf'.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding 2 new papers (total 3 including original) with valid arxiv PDF URLs. Getter returns both valid_count and total_count of URLs in column B. Metric verifies: (1) at least 3 valid URLs exist, AND (2) ALL URLs are valid (valid_count == total_count). This ensures no invalid URLs exist.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: (1) at least 3 valid URLs exist (line 18 in metric), AND (2) ALL URLs are valid with no invalid URLs (line 23: valid_count == total_count)
Getter correctly extracts both valid_count and total_count, enabling complete verification of the instruction
Metric logic is sound: returns 0.0 if either condition fails, 1.0 if both pass
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) before validation to ensure getter reads current state
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL counts → metric compares against rules → returns pass/fail
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor improvement: Getter hardcodes URL pattern ('https://arxiv.org/pdf/' and '.pdf') instead of reading from expected.url_pattern_prefix/suffix. While this works for this specific task, it would be more flexible to read patterns from the result config or pass them as parameters
